comment: CONTROL (combat payment impossible) for bruna_human_wings_swap_deferred_to_combat.json: Birds of Paradise wears Arcanum Wings and only Azorius Chancery ({W}{U}) + the Birds' own mana make the {2}{U}. An attacking Birds cannot tap for the combat swap, so the deferral would lose the Aura for the turn -- the MTG_SOLVE_COMBAT_SWAP affordability rule (s9420000 gi965) keeps the swap in the MAIN phase, paid in Colossification's respond window. The Birds then cannot attack: no damage. A deferral here would read 'deferred to COMBAT' and then fail to pay.
